themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Spain, Italy, and Poland are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in housing, social aid, and employment. This theme reflects a coordinated rhetorical and legislative effort across multiple European countries, with Vox in Spain and Lega in Italy leading the charge in regional governments.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Murcia's housing decree, forcing PP to concede; pushes similar policies in Andalusia and Castilla y León.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini's Lega backs anti-immigration rhetoric and policies, including stricter controls on migrant minors in regional governments like Aragón.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Advocates for national preference in social benefits and housing, with Bardella leading the charge in 2027 presidential polls.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Supports policies favoring Polish nationals in social aid and employment, aligning with broader far-right European trends.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 PP (Spain)
countries.note: Concedes to Vox's 'national priority' demands in Murcia and Andalusia to secure regional governance, despite internal resistance.

themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal paralyzes Argentina's government
themes.blurb: Argentina's Chief of Cabinet, Manuel Adorni, faces intense scrutiny over alleged illicit enrichment and misuse of public funds, sparking a political crisis that has paralyzed Congress and divided the ruling La Libertad Avanza coalition. The scandal has dominated domestic news and drawn international attention to Milei's administration.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Adorni's alleged illicit enrichment and misuse of public funds dominate political discourse, with Milei threatening to fire him if convicted.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 Opposition Parties (Argentina)
countries.note: Demand Adorni's interpellation in Congress, accusing the government of corruption and obstruction of justice.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 PRO (Argentina)
countries.note: Internal divisions over support for Adorni, with some members like Esteban Bullrich resigning in protest.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: International media coverage highlights the scandal's impact on Milei's pro-market reforms and alignment with Trump's policies.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The once-close alliance between former U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has publicly soured, marked by mutual insults, canceled meetings, and conflicting statements about Italy's role in U.S. military operations. This diplomatic rift reflects broader tensions within the transatlantic far-right movement.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump publicly insults Meloni, accuses Italy of undermining U.S. operations in Iran, and cancels planned meetings.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni denies Italy's involvement in U.S. strikes on Iran, contradicting NATO chief's claims and sparking diplomatic tensions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella distance themselves from Meloni, aligning more closely with Trump's rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal meets with Trump and Milei, positioning Vox as a bridge between U.S. and European far-right movements.

themes.title: AfD's constitutional crisis and far-right extremism
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces a potential constitutional ban after a legal report found it violates democratic principles. The party's extremist rhetoric, including alleged Nazi salutes and anti-immigration policies, has sparked nationwide protests and debates about the limits of free speech in German democracy.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Faces potential constitutional ban after legal report finds violations of democratic principles; party members accused of Nazi salutes.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella monitor AfD's crisis, positioning RN as a more 'moderate' far-right alternative in France.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes German establishment for targeting AfD, drawing parallels to Spain's own far-right legal challenges.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini's Lega distances itself from AfD's extremism while maintaining anti-immigration policies in Italy's coalition government.

themes.title: Poland-Ukraine tensions over historical symbols
themes.blurb: Poland's ruling Prawo i Sprawiedliwość (PiS) party has escalated tensions with Ukraine by revoking honors from Ukrainian leaders and threatening to block Ukraine's EU accession talks. The dispute centers on Ukraine's decision to honor a controversial military unit linked to WWII-era massacres of Poles, sparking a diplomatic crisis with regional implications.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Revokes Ukrainian honors from Zelensky and other leaders; threatens to block Ukraine's EU accession talks over historical disputes.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration supports Poland's stance, with Secretary of State Rubio praising Poland's historical grievances.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's government aligns with Poland, criticizing Ukraine's historical narratives and EU accession prospects.

countries.name: 🇺🇦 Ukraine
countries.note: Defends decision to honor controversial military unit, sparking diplomatic tensions with Poland and Hungary.
